notes.title: DevilishGames and Making Enemies present Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence
notes.notes:
[p]Developed by [b]Making Enemies[/b] (Ayose Trujillo) and published by the veteran studio [b]DevilishGames[/b], [i]Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence[/i] is a classic-style [b]point & click[/b] adventure that will transport players to a mysterious abbey where nothing is what it seems.[/p][p][/p][p]In this first installment of the [i]Scholar Adventure[/i] saga, players will play as [b]William[/b], a young writer searching for inspiration for his first novel. His journey takes him to a remote abbey whose monks have taken a vow of silence. What begins as a simple literary quest soon turns into a chilling enigma: within its walls lies a secret that should never have been uncovered.[/p][p][/p][p]Developed with [b]PowerQuest[/b]—the tool also used to create recent hits such as [i]The Drifter[/i]—and inspired by the graphic adventures of the 1990s, [i]Mystery of Silence[/i] combines [b]dark, detailed pixel art[/b] with a deep narrative and touches of black humor. Players will explore atmospheric environments, solve [b]environmental puzzles[/b], and use the objects they find along the way to uncover the abbey’s hidden secrets.[/p][p][/p][p]The experience will have an approximate duration of [b]two hours[/b] and is designed as a [b]tribute to the classics of the genre[/b], focusing on [b]exploration[/b], [b]puzzle-solving[/b], and [b]narrative immersion[/b]. A [b]demo version[/b] of the game will be available during the [b]Steam Next Fest in October[/b].[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929410/Scholar_Adventure_Mystery_of_Silence/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Bambas! arrives on Steam and Consoles this Friday
notes.notes: [p]Lace up your sneakers. DevilishGames is stepping up with Bambas!, a quirky new walking simulator launching this Friday on Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.[/p][p]Remember when you were a kid, and the streets were your playground, where every curb, puddle, or sidewalk turned into an epic quest? Bambas! brings back that magic with a sandbox experience that takes you on a nostalgic stroll, thanks to its innovative control system.[/p][p]Explore a lively Mediterranean coastal town brimming with personality and detail, where creativity is king and exploration is your passport to fun. Take control of each sneaker independently using the gamepad's sticks and triggers, just like moving your own feet. But walking straight won’t cut it: you’ll have to dodge crosswalks, kick cans, balance on curbs, and pull off impossible jumps to overcome hundreds of challenges and unlock a wardrobe full of customizable sneakers.[/p][p]Bambas! is more than just a game, it’s a tribute to urban culture, to worn-out soles from endless wandering, and to the stories waiting around every corner. With its non-linear narrative and environmental storytelling, you’ll discover hidden places and meet characters who’ll lead you down unexpected paths.[/p][p]Slip on your sneakers and get ready to make your mark, because every step counts here.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3274390/Bambas/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Social Simulation turnip game Minabo launches April 28th!
notes.notes:
Video games publisher [b]SelectaPlay [/b]and indie studio [b]DevilishGames[/b] announce today that [b]Minabo - A Walk Through Life[/b], the social simulation video game about life, will be released on April 28th on [b]Nintendo Switch[/b], [b]Xbox[/b], and [b]PlayStation[/b] consoles, and[b] PC[/b] (Steam).

[b]Minabo - A Walk Through Life[/b] is a cosy indie title where players have to grow their own turnip and experience its whole circle of life from beginning to end by interacting with other turnips and the environment. Make friends, create a family, and take care of pets to establish relationships in quick playthroughs.

As life progresses, players will have to make hard decisions regarding their social interactions. Would they marry a turnip and have children, or would they rather stay single and take care of their parents in their final days? [b]Minabo - A Walk Through Life[/b] is a pure (and hard) life metaphor!  

Players will enjoy appealing visuals and charming characters for all audiences while completing 25 quests full of life-changing moments inspired by psychologist counselors involved in the development. Replay with Free Life Mode to change the path again, and share their life story on social media.
